Communication in the deregulated energy market is still based on the deregulation point of delivery.

Example 2

Device 4712, containing the registers listed below, is allocated to installation 0816:

Device 4712                    Register Code                 Interval Length
Reg 1                             Watt-hour energy           15 mins
Reg 2                           Reactive consumption | 15 mins
Reg 3                             Watt-hour energy           15 mins

In the installation, register Reg. 3 performs the same meter reading tasks as register Reg. 1. For this reason, the same register code
is used for identification purposes.

Registers allocated to a point of delivery must have a unique meter reading task as described by the register code. In the following
graphic, this allocation is not unique.
